Scenario fixture: a11ycore-html-lang-attr-present

01 — FAIL: lang="english" is not a syntactically valid BCP47 language tag

This is a whole-document check (the <html> element has exactly one lang attribute), so only one outcome is possible per page. The other FAIL branches (lang attribute missing entirely, lang="" empty/whitespace) and the PASS branch (a valid tag like lang="en" or lang="fr-CH") are covered by the inline unit tests in this rule's .test.js file rather than three more near-identical fixture files.
